copy_bw_gbps.method: cudaMemcpyAsync D2D, 512 MiB, (read + write bytes) / time; median of 20 copies per rep, median of reps

dram_latency.method: dependent-load pointer chase, one thread, 128 B node stride, median of 5 repeats per point; cycles = median across points and runs; ns are derived by readers (cycles / clock)
dram_latency.ref_clock_rule: the highest source-run SM clock (clocks not locked in every source run)

l2_latency.method: dependent-load pointer chase, one thread, 128 B node stride, median of 5 repeats per point; cycles = median across points and runs; ns are derived by readers (cycles / clock)
l2_latency.ref_clock_rule: the highest source-run SM clock (clocks not locked in every source run)

note: Measured on this device (CLAUDE.md rule 8). Regenerate with aegis-perf emit-arch after re-running the probes; do not edit by hand.

read_bw_gbps.method: read-only stream, 4 independent 128-bit loads per thread per iteration (SASS-proven), 512 MiB, bytes read / time; median of 20 runs per rep, median of reps

roof_rule: memory roof: read_bw_gbps for GEMV and decode shapes (M <= 16), copy_bw_gbps elsewhere
